title: (Junior) Data Scientist Marketing / Fund Investment
description: coni + partner, established 1993, is a consultancy company with headquarters in Zurich and subsidiaries in Düsseldorf and Shanghai. We are specialised in custom-fit staffing in tune with the corporate culture by ensuring a perfect match of professional skills, references and personal as well as social skills of successful candidates. Our client is the asset management division of an international bank in Zurich. We are looking for data scientists (m, f, d) with experience in the fund business as (Junior) Data Scientist Marketing / Fund Investment Your Tasks: Responsible for data analysis services to support business activities using data on fund investments, performance, portfolio management or investor data in the areas of product and portfolio management, marketing, sales, customer service and investor relation / Working closely with the investment management team and front-office teams to produce accurate input data and ensure that analyses and results accurately reflect the fund’s investment strategy / Supporting business activities by analysing data from investment databases and managing key data sets used to respond to e.g. offers, due diligence questionnaires and client enquiries / Providing high-quality, accurate and timely analysis of data to the investor relations and client services teams / Maintaining databases of third-party providers and advisers, collaborating to continuously improve the content library, and contributing to ad hoc projects / Ensuring the consistency and integrity of the data recorded, and continuously improving data quality, automation, AI tools and process efficiency. Your Profile: Bachelor’s or Master’s in quantitative finance or economics / An advantage when working towards CFA or CAIA certification / After graduation, 2 to 3 years’ professional experience in data science within a marketing- or sales-oriented area of the fund industry, e.g. as a quantitative consultant at one of the ‘Big Four’ accountancy firms or as a data scientist at a major asset manager / Interested in using AI-assisted tools / Skilled with Python, SQL, Big Data technologies / Analytical personality with the ability to take a holistic view of both the details and the bigger picture / Team-oriented and open to discussion, with a collegial approach / Highly self-motivated / Interest in project and coordination work / English fluent and other languages an asset. Your Contact: Mr. Ivano Coni would like to support you.
